motivation.argument: The bias grows as the estimate shrinks, and V122 changed only weights, so CatBoost's season heterogeneity cannot explain it. All three folds predict the season immediately after their training window, exactly as 2025 will, and V121 showed history depth irrelevant, so they are three equally valid measurements rather than one plus two distractions.

instrument: Equally weighted average of the three per-season means, with SE combined from each season's stored interval. Deliberately not a pooled bootstrap: 2023's gains run three to seven times the others', so row pooling lets it dominate, which is how V95 was misled.
unchanged: Monthly block win rate floor of 75%. Consistency across twenty blocks is a different kind of evidence and nothing in the leaderboard record impugns it.
